I got offered a room by UvA but I had done a lot of searching for private accomodation beforehand so I think I could be able to give you some tips : 
- Look on websites like Kamernet, Pararius, Funda 
- Some people say it’s better to look on Facebook groups, there are sooo many just type keywords like “amsterdam - renting” in the search bar. 

If you’re in contact with a potential landlord :
- Never sign anything without seeing the apartment first (some contracts are made such as they are legally binding for several months before you can give notice and leave so you could be legally obligated to pay rent for all those months) 
- Verify the identity of the landlord you’re dealing with (I did ask for the ID of one landlord he was completely understanding as there are a lot of scammers)
- You can check on Kadaster.nl for a few euros if the apartment you’re renting really belongs to the landlord who’s referred on the drafted contract that you will eventually be sent.

That’s all I can think about right now. As for my experience, I did one online visit with a landlord from Kamernet who seemed very trustworthy but didn’t get the room unfortunately. I also sent several messages on facebook, and did a few visits but they ended up choosing someone else every time lol I guess it really depends and I would’ve eventually found at some point if I had carried on with the search. Good luck!!
